sources.compatibility: Mario Kart 8 Deluxe 3.0.3 only. The publisher explicitly says 1.1.1 does not support other game updates. Players using wireless/LAN must use the matching CTGP version.
sources.requirements: An existing modded Switch and the supported game update. The publisher recommends emuMMC. Download is about 3.86 GB and unpacks to about 4.52 GB; allow room for both on your computer.

release.title: CTGP Deluxe
release.name: CTGPDX-v1.1.1.zip
release.installPath: SD root; preserve supplied atmosphere/ and companion folders

sources.compatibility: MK8 Deluxe 3.0.5, build ID FE941ED5BA14BE5D505698DA1BBF4FE7 only. Title ID 0100152000022000. The author reports real-Atmosphère testing for Spain on 3.0.5; this GB variant is not separately hardware-tested here.
sources.requirements: Atmosphère and a compatible Nextendo setup. Install exactly one country patch. This changes country presentation, not race behaviour or matchmaking.

sources.compatibility: MK8 Deluxe 4.0.0, build ID 2C336A9BCF79C3040CE506CDD391B578 only. Title ID 0100152000022000. The author lists Atmosphère support, with the documented 4.0.0 test performed on Ryujinx.
sources.requirements: Atmosphère and a compatible Nextendo setup. Install one country patch and match the game build ID exactly. This does not make CTGP Deluxe compatible with 4.0.0.

sources.compatibility: Switch build for Smash Ultimate with Atmosphère and Skyline. The selected release does not enumerate an exact game-version range; check current project notes before changing your game update.
sources.requirements: Skyline runtime. Its complete ZIP includes the mod's support files. The project lists Minecraft Skins as a known conflict and does not support placing this pack in /ultimate/mods/ as a chainloaded mod.

sources.compatibility: The current author documentation lists Smash Ultimate 13.0.2, 13.0.3, 13.0.4 and 13.0.5. Do not infer support for another update from that list.
sources.requirements: Atmosphère, ARCropolis, Skyline, NRO Hook and the matching Smashline runtime. Smashline 2.0.0 changed APIs after this mod release; read the migration notes and match the version required by the mod. Announcer-voice mods can conflict.

sources.compatibility: Requires the project-supported Smash Ultimate revision and Atmosphère. The selected release page does not provide an exact supported game-version table; check the project before installation.
sources.requirements: The full Switch ZIP is about 1.25 GiB. Its launcher and supporting plugin/resource files belong together. The small upgrade ZIP is not a complete first installation.

release.title: HewDraw Remix full Switch package
release.name: switch-package.zip
release.installPath: SD root; keep atmosphere/ and ultimate/ together

sources.compatibility: Atmosphère and a compatible Smash Ultimate revision. The selected release does not enumerate a universal firmware/game-version range. Skyline is distributed separately.
sources.requirements: Skyline runtime and the complete ARCropolis release, including its menu resources. This is a game-loaded plugin, not an hbmenu application. Keep mod authors’ game-version and dependency requirements.
sources.inspectedPackageEvidence: Official v4.1.1 release.zip contains both atmosphere/contents/.../libarcropolis.nro and ultimate/arcropolis/resources/ menu files; preserve both complete folder trees.

sources.compatibility: The official beta asset checked on 2 November 2026. This is a mutable upstream beta tag, so the archived SHA-256 identifies the precise build. Other games can require their own Skyline variant.
sources.requirements: An existing Atmosphère setup. Use the supplied Smash main.npdm with Smash; do not copy this whole runtime into unrelated games.

sources.compatibility: Use only when the selected mod requires this API generation. It is an alternative to 2.0.0, not a second plugin to install alongside it. Game and moveset compatibility still depends on the mod.
sources.requirements: Skyline and a compatible moveset mod. The newer 2.0.0 runtime can crash older plugins using changed cloning APIs; match the author's instructions.

sources.compatibility: Released 28 October 2026. The project warns that earlier moveset plugins may be incompatible. A newer runtime does not establish compatibility for an older mod pack.
sources.requirements: Skyline and matching mod plugins. Read the major-update notes before changing an existing working setup.

sources.compatibility: Install when the selected mod calls for this plugin. The source release is older and does not document a current universal game/firmware range.
sources.requirements: Skyline and a dependent mod. Existing complete packs may already include libnro_hook.nro; keep one intended active copy.

sources.compatibility: A matching HDR setup with Skyline and the project's required web/plugin dependencies. For a fresh install, use the complete HDR Switch pack.
sources.requirements: This NRO is a game-loaded component. It is not a standalone hbmenu app or the full HDR mod.

sources.compatibility: Super Mario Odyssey 1.0.0 only. This selected speedrun release excludes the game modes, twists and capture synchronization advertised by other SMOO+ versions.
sources.requirements: An existing modded Switch and a reachable compatible SMOO server. PC server software runs on another device; the provided ZIP is the console mod only. Do not stack it with another Odyssey exefs mod.
sources.inspectedPackageEvidence: Release ZIP has a SMOO-Plus-Speedrun-Switch/ wrapper; copy the contained atmosphere/ folder to SD root. Title ID 0100000000010000 verified in archive members.
